title: Key April 2026 Appointments: Ashwini Bhide (BMC), Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth (VCOAS), John Ternus (Apple)
summary: Major executive changes including BMC's 1st woman commissioner, new Vice Chief of Army Staff, and Apple's next CEO.

blocks.title: 📰 10. 📌 MISCELLANEOUS — GOVT SCHEMES & STATIC
blocks.text: 🪝 Key April 2026 Appointments: Ashwini Bhide (BMC), Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth (VCOAS), John Ternus (Apple). Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: **BMC Commissioner**: Ashwini Bhide appointed Municipal Commissioner of Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (1st woman head).
**Army VCOAS**: Lt Gen Dhiraj Seth assumed office as 49th Vice Chief of Army Staff.
**Apple CEO**: John Ternus named CEO w.e.f. Sept 1, 2026 (Tim Cook becomes Executive Chairman).
**Yes Bank MD & CEO**: Vinay Muralidhar Tonse took charge for 3 years.
**Bihar CM**: Samrat Choudhary sworn in as 24th CM of Bihar (1st BJP CM).
